hazards.control: BOP drills before the job; kill weight fluid or a tested barrier before the tree comes off.
Test the stack to the program pressures; bleed and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Stripping and snubbing stack
function: The stack of strippers and rams used to move pipe through a sealed wellhead under pressure on a snubbing job.

tabs.overview: Two stripping rams or a stripper rubber alternate to pass connections; safety rams below for well control; equalizing loop between them.
tabs.engineering: Per API Std 53 for hydraulic workover; ratings with the well pressure.
tabs.safety: Sequenced closures; never both strippers open with pressure below.
tabs.evidence: API Spec 16A (S48), API Std 53 (S49), API RP 16ST (S53), field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
